llm.summary: This skill gives instructions for using Pruna's API to animate an image using a source video, with the expected uploads and API key use disclosed.

dimensions.detail: Network use, PRUNA_API_KEY use, and media uploads are proportionate to the API-based video generation purpose and are described in the skill text.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill recommends installing companion Pruna skills with npx commands, but does not include executable scripts or automatic install behavior in this artifact.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are scoped to prompt preparation, explicit user input confirmation, asset upload, prediction creation, polling, and download through Pruna-related workflows.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background worker, privilege escalation, local indexing, destructive action, or hidden credential handling was found in the inspected artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is motion transfer/video animation, and the instructions focus on gathering an image, a source video, prompt fields, and calling the p-video-animate API.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, understand that using this skill means sending selected images and videos to Pruna's API with your PRUNA_API_KEY. Only use media you are allowed to upload, review generated prompts before paid calls, and be cautious with optional fields such as disabling safety checks.
